quests.title: First Steps Behind the Bar
quests.description: The Wandering Flagon is yours now, ink still wet on the deed. Prove the taps still work: see two orders reach two tables.

quests.title: Open the Books
quests.description: Grandfather Aldous kept his ledger in the counter drawer. Open the Keeper's Ledger and look the numbers in the eye.

quests.title: Stock the Cellar
quests.description: Empty barrels serve nobody. Order a fresh batch of anything before the taps run dry.

objectives.label: Restock any item from the Ledger

quests.title: Word of Mouth
quests.description: A tavern lives on its regulars' tongues. Send three paying guests into the night with coin left on your counter.

quests.title: The Courier's Satchel
quests.description: A courier named Maren has been asking for the new keeper. She carries something of Aldous's — find her when she stops by.

quests.title: A House in Order
quests.description: Aldous let the place tire out in his last years. Put real coin into one improvement and make the Flagon yours.

quests.title: The Old Chill
quests.description: Maren mentioned the pale folk used to drink here in Aldous's day, quiet as snowfall. Keep the door open late and see one arrive.

objectives.label: Have an undead patron visit the tavern

quests.title: Fenwick's Tale
quests.description: Old Fenwick drank beside your grandfather for forty years, and dwarves forget nothing they drank to. He knows what sits beneath these boards.

quests.title: Beneath the Boards
quests.description: Fenwick swears the old truce-hall never burned — it was buried. Search the cellar for the stone he described.

objectives.label: Find and examine the Accord Stone in the cellar

quests.title: Letters from Aldous
quests.description: Maren held back one last letter — Aldous told her to wait until you'd 'seen the cellar properly.' She'll come by again; be ready.

objectives.label: Receive Aldous's last letter from Maren

quests.title: The Pale Guest
quests.description: Aldous's letter names a witness who signed the Accord and never stopped keeping it: Vess. The letter says only — 'she comes when the candles gutter.'

quests.title: Dwarven Thirst
quests.description: Win the mountain trade: dwarves pay steady and drink deep, but only where the ale never disappoints.

quests.title: Elven Grace
quests.description: Elves tip like lords and judge like magistrates. Earn their regard and the Flagon's name will travel far roads.

quests.title: A Round of Peace
quests.description: Fists are not the only way to end a fight. Next time tempers snap, stand a round on the house and talk them down (G).

objectives.label: End a brawl peacefully with a round on the house

quests.title: The Iron Hand
quests.description: Sometimes the room only respects a firm grip. See two brawls stopped — by your own shove or the bouncer's shoulders.

quests.title: Boiling Point
quests.description: Every keeper meets the night the whole room bares its teeth. When tension boils over, bring it all the way back down to calm.

objectives.label: Bring a CRITICAL room back to CALM

quests.title: Mend the Hall
quests.description: Splintered stools tell every guest the same story: this house is losing. Pay off the damage and make the hall whole.

objectives.label: Pay for furniture repairs in the Ledger

quests.title: No Blood Tonight
quests.description: Fenwick's wager: even Aldous never kept a full day without a single fight. Prove the old dwarf wrong — one day, zero brawls.

objectives.label: Finish a full day without a single brawl

quests.title: The Rainy Day Fund
quests.description: Aldous kept five hundred copper behind a loose brick 'for the bad winter.' Build the Flagon's reserve back to that mark.

quests.title: What the Stone Asks
quests.description: The Accord Stone is failing, and Vess offers you the same choice she once gave Aldous: pour your will into the old truce, or let it fade and keep the coin it costs. She will hear your answer when you next speak.

quests.title: The Gathering Night
quests.description: Whatever you chose, the Flagon must prove it can hold the peace the old hall promised. Fill the room — five guests seated at once — and keep the air easy while you do.

objectives.label: Have 5 patrons seated at once while the room stays calm

quests.title: A Keeper's Legacy
quests.description: The hall held. The letters are answered, the stone has its answer, and the road knows the Flagon's name again. All that remains is what Aldous wanted most: a full till and a quiet heart.
